snippet.title: CyberThreat - Meet the Hackers - Indie Quest 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the reveal of CyberThreat's newest and final member of the Hackers, Maya Cordova, aka Justice, featured in Indie Quest 2025!

Huge thanks to @TheGamingShelf for including CyberThreat as part of their amazing showcase, be sure to check out the full presentation and wishlist all the wonderful games on display there!
